picks.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
picks.excerpt: Shopify says more than a billion product listings from its merchants will be available to third-party AI shopping agents, widening agentic commerce distribution beyond its existing partners.
picks.rationale: Over a billion Shopify listings opened to third-party AI shopping agents, which turns agent chat into a sales channel that merchants have to plan for.

picks.title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
picks.excerpt: American Express published an 'intent intelligence' framework so merchants can verify that an AI shopping agent's purchase matches what the cardholder actually authorized, aiming to cut disputes as agentic checkout grows.
picks.rationale: Amex has published a framework that lets merchants check an agent's purchase against what the cardholder authorized. It is a concrete trust layer for agentic checkout at the point of sale.

picks.title: Salesforce trains its Koa model on 27 years of CRM workflow simulations
picks.excerpt: Salesforce's chief data officer says its Koa model was trained on simulations of 27 years of CRM sales and service workflows, while customers can still swap in Claude, ChatGPT, open or custom models for Agentforce agents.
picks.rationale: Salesforce's own Koa model for sales and service agents comes with model choice inside Agentforce. It is a concrete change to the CRM and sales-automation stack.

picks.title: Bannerflow now scores ads for attention before any budget is spent
picks.excerpt: Bannerflow's new Creative Intelligence suite adds AI attention heatmaps and clarity scores to pre-test ad creative before launch, alongside AI image tools and plain-language feed setup; pricing and validation data are not yet disclosed.
picks.rationale: AI attention heatmaps and clarity scores pre-test ad creative before media spend. This directly changes how creative teams ship ads.

alternates.title: Meta's shopping agent must fill its top 5 picks with well-known merchants
alternates.excerpt: An instruction file for Meta's Muse shopping agent requires its top five product picks to come from well-known merchants, and only Meta catalog items get in-chat checkout, leaving challenger brands outside the comparison.
alternates.rationale: Backup only. This is the 10-13 curator's dropped Muse 'well-known merchants' item (running Muse story, published 10-11/10-12), and it would also be a third PPC Land card.
